baseline.causal_observation: The target-field positive and negative SAM points are at least 96.7% and 100% label-consistent respectively, while the majority-vote SAM masks have high precision but severe recall loss. This registers a readout-undercoverage failure, not a field-fidelity failure.

method.coarse_mask: target signed field cosine margin greater than or equal to zero
method.coarse_resize: nearest to the fixed 1008x756 transient SAM raster
method.box: tight coarse-mask box plus 16 pixels on every available side, represented as normalized cxcywh
method.target_rgb: query-transient and opened only after the complete signed-field prompt manifest is verified
method.candidate_selection: maximum IoU with the sealed coarse field mask, tie by higher SAM score

inherited_parameter_authority.note: Padding, overlap gate, normalized box semantics, and target-blind candidate selector are inherited without NVOS target tuning.

evaluation_barrier.evaluator: the unchanged frozen NVOS full8 evaluator

promotion_gate.reason: The candidate must beat both the frozen Method-v1 baseline and the already-observed target-blind any-trial diagnostic rather than merely recover from the known majority-vote bug.
